# Unicorn Studio header scene

The original homepage hero scene, downloaded on 2026-10-05:

- Scene: https://www.unicorn.studio/us_home_flat.json
- Runtime: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/hiunicornstudio/unicornstudio.js@v2.1.12/dist/unicornStudio.umd.js
- Embed documentation: https://github.com/hiunicornstudio/unicornstudio.js

These files are the unmodified scene export and official 2.1.12 runtime.
Both are served locally; rendering this scene requires no third-party requests.
Its original shader and star layer retain their colors and animation. The kb
header crops and fades the canvas to keep the surrounding text readable.
